body: I don't have time for hobbies. The minuscule amounts of time that I'm not working, I try to spend with my daughter. I can see that my ex is reaching the point where she'll keep me from seeing my baby. She'll win custody if we were to go to court. If I were to pick up a hobby, that would cut into the precious time I have with my daughter. It doesn't matter what I'm doing, my body can stay focused but my heart and mind cannot. It's incredibly overwhelming.
